meta.title: PDF reading · ask as you read
meta.description: A workbench for close reading of full-page PDFs, opened from the “PDF reading” sidebar entry. Libraries and shelves are organised as book → chapter; the reader supports single/continuous pages, ink and marquee annotations, an off-page canvas, bilingual view and translation overlays. Each chapter can start extract, Q&A and exercise conversations, and also carries attachments, printing and machine-to-machine migration. Libraries and notes stay on this machine; PDFs are never pushed into model context automatically. Translation needs Python + a DeepSeek API key; PPT-to-PDF optionally uses local Office or LibreOffice.
